context: A uni student helps a teen friend plan a recording project
purpose: Teach: ピアニスト/レコーダー/音源/綿/おばあさん/民家/プロセッサ/早稲田

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 先輩、自宅で音源を録音したいんです。
lines.en: Senpai, I want to record a vocal track at home.
lines.style: Direct, respectful request. Quick uptake at the start. A hint of nervous hope underneath—asking for permission and guidance from someone she trusts.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: いいね。プロセッサ強めのPCあれば編集も楽。
lines.en: That could work. If you've got a computer with a decent processor, the editing's not too painful.
lines.style: Thoughtful, already problem-solving. Warm and encouraging without overselling it. Slight technical confidence in the tone—he knows this terrain.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 近所のピアニストのおばあさんに、伴奏お願いするつもりです。
lines.en: I'm planning to ask the elderly pianist who lives nearby to play accompaniment.
lines.style: Animated disclosure. She's thought this through. Light lift on 'pianist'—small pride in the idea. Conversational, like she's sharing the plan not seeking approval this time.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 録音は静かな民家で。レコーダーは私のを貸す。
lines.en: We should record somewhere quiet—a home space. I can lend you my recorder.
lines.style: Practical and warm. Settling into logistics. The offer of the recorder lands softly—gift without fanfare. Steady, reliable tone.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 綿のクッション、防音用に揃えるね。
lines.en: I'll get some cotton cushions to help with dampening the sound.
lines.style: Focused, slightly matter-of-fact. She's moved into action mode. Quick, efficient—no hesitation. The tone says she's already visualizing the setup.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 早稲田の音楽研究会も招待しよう。
lines.en: We should invite people from the Waseda music circle too. Make it something real.
lines.style: Opening up the vision. Warmer, more expansive than before. A gentle invitation to make this bigger than just the two of them. Encouraging without pressure.
